market_question: Will New People (NL) gain the most seats in the next Russian parliamentary election?
reasoning: New People gained 13 seats in 2021, while CPRF gained 15, making it unlikely that a newer Kremlin-aligned party would be the top gainer in a highly controlled 2026 election, where United Russia’s dominance and suppression of opposition are expected to limit gains for any outsider.
evidence_points: In 2021, New People gained 13 seats (from 0) but CPRF gained 15, so the top-gainer threshold was modest.
Since 2021, political repression has intensified, and systemic opposition parties like New People may be allowed only limited growth to preserve United Russia’s supermajority.
Wartime nationalism typically benefits the incumbent party, reducing the chance that an opposition party (even one perceived as loyal) will see the largest seat increase.
